files.role: Trusted source-gate workflow: focused and release-ready conditions change always() to !cancelled(); functional steps, aggregation bodies and failure requirements unchanged.
files.patch:
@@ -233,11 +233,12 @@ jobs:
 
   focused:
     # Keep the existing required status: no individual shard can qualify the gate.
+    # Aggregate failed dependencies, but let cancellation retire an obsolete run.
     if: >-
-      always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
+      ${{ !cancelled() && github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
       needs.preflight.result == 'success' &&
       needs.preflight.outputs.admission != 'hold' &&
-      needs.preflight.outputs.focusedRequired == 'true'
+      needs.preflight.outputs.focusedRequired == 'true' }}
     needs: [preflight, focused_shards]
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     timeout-minutes: 5
@@ -438,7 +439,8 @@ jobs:

source.policyImpact: Changing the trusted workflow changes its accepted automation identity. Earlier-policy checks remain historical source evidence and must not be presented as acceptance under the new policy. Fresh exact-source/policy-bound receipts and normal controller requirements apply after integration.

finding: No production dependency of the held lifecycle, MP3 inspection, artwork or trail repairs requires Worlds/Missions preparation, Soundtrack authoring or backup-observer acceptance first. Those P2 branches depend on the initial release cohort, not the reverse. The unresolved Worlds fixture/source admission failure need not block first execution of confirmed gameplay repair controls.

recommendedSequence.action: Preserve unchanged ready heads #1619,#1620,#1621,#1628 through their ordinary guarded merges. Complete and review both engines of the bounded P0 published observation, retaining exact public identity and every terminal outcome.

Reconcile #1654 once against fresh main; complete fresh required source/policy qualification and the existing guarded policy-change merge procedure. No bypass of controller restrictions or retrospective reuse of stale policy receipts.

Admit held lifecycle and MP3 repairs first, then artwork/trail source validation against the accepted main/policy. Retain independent review and meaningful replay, cancellation, ownership, generated-output and combined-source checks.

Release P2 #1674/#1675/#1676 after the P1 repair source-qualification milestone, using fresh main/trusted-policy evidence where required. Existing useful P2 CI continues and all original results remain retained.

guards: Do not edit the four ready heads or invalidate their admitted gate receipts before their merges and P0 observation.

P0 means a completed, reviewed terminal observation, not an assertion of success. If a severe product failure is found, triage and prioritize the repair without making its first qualification depend on passing the affected flow. Final acceptance still requires the original scenario gates.

Original trace-v2 remains before heap/overhead changes to shared adapters. Preserve historical declarations, failures, workload and owner limits; check exact source/workflow binding and artifact availability before dispatch.
No useful active P2 functional jobs are cancelled for this reprioritization. An old-policy pass is preserved but does not automatically qualify a new-policy combined source.
No readiness, branches, PRs, merge, dispatch, retries, tests, local files, app or browser execution changed by this review.
riskAndBenefit: Removes an avoidable critical-path dependency on P2 Worlds admission before confirmed P1 gameplay defects can receive functional tests.
Does not promise reduced hosted runner wait or total completion time. #1654 fixes demonstrated obsolete aggregate retention; account-wide queue behavior remains unproven.
Fresh integration may reveal source/generated/test-closure conflicts; retain distinct source-reviewed, test-passed, merged, published and native-qualified states.
